description: TSW resolves three pairwise-distance-2 haplotypes into a star through one internal vertex
derivation: Hand-traced against TightSpanWalker::geodesic. Sequences AAT, ATA, TAA: all pairwise distances 2, and dT(i,j)=2 for every pair (the k==i term |d(i,i)-d(j,i)| dominates). geodesic(H2,H1): the auxiliary graph K has edges (H2,H1) and (H3,H2); seeding greens H1 and BFS greens H3; delta = (dT(f,H3)+dT(f,H1)-d(H3,H1))/2 = 1 < dT(f,g)=2, so internal vertex h with dT-vector (1,1,1) is created and edge H2-h (weight 1) added; continuing from h, delta=1 equals dT(h,H1) and edge h-H1 lands. geodesic(H3,H1) reaches the same memoised dT-vector (1,1,1), adds H3-h, and the final step finds h-H1 already present. Result: a star on the internal vertex with three unit edges. Ids by sorted sequence: AAT->H1, ATA->H2, TAA->H3; the internal vertex is Median_0.
